messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated errors and routing churn detected for /v1/chat.generate in prod (eu-west-1). Auto-fallbacks firing repeatedly. Paging oncall.
oncall-ml: here, acknowledged. seeing spikes in 422/400 validation errors and a burst of model-swap events around 09:12 UTC. collecting traces.
sre-maya: pulling the routing decision logs now. initial traffic meant for redwood-chat-fp16-v5, then switched to redwood-chat-quant-lite-eu as fallback. quant-lite returns validation errors when requests include 'tool_calls' field.
platform-bryan: pasted excerpt from routing decision context:
```
route: /v1/chat.generate
selected_primary: redwood-chat-fp16-v5
fallbacks:
  - redwood-chat-quant-lite-eu (budgeted)
  - redwood-chat-fp16-us (cross-region)
capability_assumed: [tool_calls:true, streaming:true]
```
oncall-ml: that capability_assumed bit is dangerous. our model registry doesn't currently expose per-model tool_calling flag for quant variants. routing engine treated fallback as drop-in compatible.
deploy-bot: FYI quant-lite-eu was auto-promoted as a cost-saving canary on 2026-03-10; deploy logs show unit tests but no integration test for tool-calling.
support-lina: support queue: 5 tickets labelled 'tool call failed' from EU customers (Catalyst, MedLink, RetailCo). Reported start 09:12 UTC. Customers saw 400 responses and missing external action webhooks.

sre-maya: quick mitigation: disable model selection to quant variants for any request with tool_calls present. running command now.

sre-maya: mitigation executed:
```
rwctl routing update --route /v1/chat.generate --disable-fallbacks-with-flag tool_calls
```
Observability: error rate dropping within 3 minutes. routing churn stopped. latency slightly up but acceptable.
oncall-eu: I will hold the oncall handoff. leaving a note for tomorrow shift to finish postmortem.

platform-bryan: root cause: model capability mismatch (quant variant lacks tool_calling shim and has shorter effective context mapping), routing engine lacked pre-check for capability before selecting fallback. Health probes interpreted 400s as transient model failure and retried other fallbacks -> cascading flips to other regions.

sre-maya: immediate completed steps:
- blocked quant variants from serving tool_calls (temporary rule)
- relaxed noisy alert to avoid duplicate pages during mitigation
- alerted support to contact impacted customers

support-lina: affected customers and summary:
- Catalyst: failed webhook triggers, ops notified
- MedLink: clinical workflow interrupted (low tolerance), oncall notified
- RetailCo: some order-sourcing automation failed, account team notified
I will prepare a customer advisory template and schedule outreach.

oncall-ml: longer-term action items (logged):
- extend model registry to include capability flags: tool_calls, streaming, max_context_tokens, kv_cache_compatible
- add capability compatibility check to routing engine before fallback selection
- require integration canary that runs representative tool_call flow before promoting any quant or trimmed-context model
- emit a metric 'capability_mismatch_rate' and alert if >0.5% of requests
- update deploy pipeline: prevent auto-promotion of model that fails representative feature smoke tests
- update runbook for rapid route pinning and opt-out of cross-region fallback

pm-isha: scheduling: prioritize compatibility matrix & routing guard as P0 for next board sprint. assign to platform and infra.

deploy-bot: rollout note: a rollback of the quant-lite promotion will be performed to staging for further testing; will not re-promote until tests added.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: temporary routing guard applied. Please document postmortem and link findings.

sre-maya: taking ownership of postmortem draft. I'll include timeline, RCA, mitigation steps, and action owners. ETA EOD tomorrow.
oncall-eu: handoff to follow-up: I'll validate there are no residual failed requests and coordinate replay for customers whose requests errored.

support-lina: prepping customer impact summary for legal/compliance where needed.

pm-isha: thanks all. tagging Jira: IR-2026-03-19-compat-matrix. assign owners and track to closure.
